intro.zh: 我是上海科技大学电子科学与技术专业硕士研究生，本科毕业于上科大电子信息工程专业。我的研究兴趣在于触觉感知与机器人操作的交叉领域。这里记录我的学习笔记、项目与研究工作。
intro.en: I am a master's student in Electronic Science and Technology at ShanghaiTech University, having completed my bachelor's degree in Electronic Information Engineering there. My research interests sit at the intersection of tactile sensing and robotic manipulation. This site collects my study notes, projects, and research work.

lead.zh: 我的研究兴趣在于以触觉感知推进机器人操作。
lead.en: My research interests lie in pushing forward robotic manipulation with tactile sensing.
